title: Playlist and Mixtape
author: Silas Ishikawa
blurb: Ada Crane, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
